title: Adventure & Activity-Based Trips from Delhi
content:
If you’re someone who craves adventure more than relaxation, this page is for you! From mountain treks and river rafting to paragliding and camping, Delhi’s proximity to the Himalayas and the Shivalik range makes it an adventure hub. Whether you’re a beginner or an adrenaline junkie, these activity-based destinations promise an unforgettable long weekend.

1. Rishikesh – River Rafting & Bungee Jumping

Distance: 240 km (6 hours drive)
Best Time to Visit: September to June
Famous For: White-water rafting, bungee jumping, camping, and yoga

3-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Drive from Delhi to Rishikesh, check into a riverside camp. Evening Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat.

Day 2: Early morning river rafting (Shivpuri stretch), bungee jumping, and cliff jumping.

Day 3: Visit Beatles Ashram or Lakshman Jhula before returning to Delhi.

2. Bir Billing - Paragliding Capital of India

Distance: 500 km (9-10 hours drive or overnight bus/train to Pathankot)
Best Time to Visit: March to June & October to November
Famous For: Paragliding, trekking, and mountain camping

3-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Arrive at Bir, enjoy a walk through Tibetan monasteries.

Day 2: Paragliding from Billing (8,000 ft), visit local cafés and sunset point.

Day 3: Local sightseeing or short trek before departure.

3. Tirthan Valley – Trekking & Trout Fishing

Distance: 500 km (10 hours drive)
Best Time to Visit: March to June & September to November
Famous For: Great Himalayan National Park treks, riverside camping, fishing

3-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Delhi to Tirthan, check into a riverside homestay or camp.

Day 2: Trek to waterfalls or short trail inside Great Himalayan National Park.

Day 3: Visit Jibhi or Jalori Pass before heading back.

4. Manali - Adventure Capital of Himachal

Distance: 540 km (12-13 hours drive)
Best Time to Visit: Throughout the year (avoid monsoon)
Famous For: River rafting, zorbing, paragliding, skiing (in winter)

3-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Overnight journey to Manali, check into hotel.

Day 2: Adventure day - paragliding in Solang Valley, rafting in Beas River.

Day 3: Local sightseeing or short trek to Jogini Falls, return to Delhi.

5. Neemrana & Sohna – Quick Adventure Escapes

Distance: 120 km (2-3 hours drive)
Best Time to Visit: October to March
Famous For: Ziplining, fort stays, ATV rides, and hot springs

3-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Drive to Neemrana, enjoy ziplining and explore Neemrana Fort.

Day 2: Head to Sohna for spa and adventure park activities.

Day 3: Visit Damdama Lake for kayaking or rock climbing before returning.

6. Kasol & Kheerganga - Trekking & Camping

Distance: 520 km (12-13 hours drive)
Best Time to Visit: March to June & September to November
Famous For: Kheerganga trek, camping by Parvati River, hippie cafés

3-Day Itinerary:

Day 1: Overnight journey to Kasol, relax by the river and explore Manikaran Sahib.

Day 2: Start Kheerganga trek, camp at the top amid the Himalayas.

Day 3: Descend and head back to Delhi.

How to Reach

All destinations are accessible by road from Delhi. Overnight Volvo buses or trains are available for Rishikesh, Manali, and Bir. Self-driving is also popular for weekend adventure seekers.

Travel Tips for Adventure Trips

  • Book adventure activities in advance with certified operators.
  • Always wear proper gear and safety equipment.
  • Carry a first-aid kit, sunscreen, and a power bank.
  • Respect nature - avoid littering during treks or camping.
excerpt: Unleash your adventurous side with thrilling weekend getaways from Delhi. Enjoy rafting in Rishikesh, paragliding in Bir Billing, trekking in Kasol, and camping in Tirthan Valley. Perfect for thrill-seekers looking for an exciting escape close to nature.
